entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Riga–Jelgava Railway is a 43 kilometres (27 mi) long, 1,524 mm gauge railway built in the 19th century to connect the cities of Riga and Jelgava. In 1872, an extension was built from Jelgava to Mažeikiai, which connected Riga–Jelgava Railway to the Libava–Romny Railway.
